description: Parses a camt.053.001 bank-to-customer statement XML document with the same schema-subset structural and facet checks as the tools/565 browser reconciliation workbench (IBAN mod-97, BIC, currency, date/decimal facets), returning the extracted statement (message id, statement id, account IBAN/currency, balances, entries) on success or the structural error list on failure. Byte-identical extraction to the browser tool for the same input. Read-only parse -- feed the result to recon_match for reconciliation.
